summary: TD Bank filed a Form 6-K on October 9, 2026, disclosing that Canada's Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions approved its previously announced common share buyback for cancellation of up to C$10 billion, capped at 61 million shares, commencing October 9, 2026. No price per share, premium, advisor or expiry date is stated. The program is a normal-course issuer bid conducted under Canadian rules (the equivalent of a US issuer tender/buyback), funded from the bank's capital; regulatory approval was the gating condition. Watch actual repurchase pace, dilution of the 61 million-share cap relative to shares outstanding, and any capital or earnings constraints limiting execution.
